result.summary: Found 3 issues: category cards and restaurant cards are cut off at screen edge, and the third 'Fastest near you' card content is obscured, indicating horizontal scroll clipping problems.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen, hiding delivery info and truncating the name
issues.suggestion: Add clearer scroll affordance (e.g., partial card peek with fade gradient) or adjust card width so cut-off is intentional and visually indicated

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right side suggesting more categories exist but no visual scroll indicator is present
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or scroll indicator to signal horizontally scrollable content

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated without ellipsis due to card being cut off by screen edge rather than text truncation styling
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncates with ellipsis within visible card bounds or ensure card fully fits before cutoff
